<!-- pr-reviewer: 3a72af775c3e4517a6d1b88691dddd63fa1dfaf2 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for the careful slice, and for moving it over from #399.

**What looks good**
- The change is small and layered correctly: reads and placement live in `crates/app/src/tool_body_view.rs`, ui stays thin, and no components were added outside `schema.rs`.
- Apply and Clear body are a single `SetToolBody` each (one undo step). Picks only fill fields and queue nothing. Refusals are named in the editor.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` on the new non-test paths. Direction and normal maths go through `norm`, which refuses non-finite or zero vectors. The envelope drawing skips non-finite or non-positive bands.
- No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes, so a normal build was fine.
- Provenance lines are present, the new files are under 400 lines (`tool_body_page.rs` 308, `state_tool_body.rs` 264), and `docs/decisions/371-tool-body-ui.md` is in place.
- No `CHANGELOG.md` edit. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #371`.
- The hands-on GUI check from #399 is recorded in the PR comment.

**Local results (merged with current upstream main, clean merge, macOS)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `tool_body_view` | 8 passed |
| app `tool_body` | 8 passed |
| ui `--test operations` | 31 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 351 passed, 2 failed, 2 ignored |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The two lib failures are the ones the PR describes:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds - No suitable graphics adapter found (no GPU adapter on this Mac)
egui_app::tests::tool_editor_snapshot  - pixel golden; the editor gained a column, and no GPU adapter here
```
The `tool_editor_snapshot` PNG differs by design (pixel goldens are refreshed at the cut), so I am not treating it as a defect.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `pages.rs` (1916 lines) and `state.rs` (3873 lines) were already over the 400-line guide and grew a little. The new code went into new files, which is the right direction.
- The body file is read on the UI thread, so a very large vendor STEP will briefly freeze the window. The PR already calls this out.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
